verdict.rationale: Moosend is an email marketing SaaS that advertises AI-powered suggestions, so an AI-training data opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains no documented control, policy or setting that stops customer data from being used to train AI models. The note that account data stays intact after a trial is about retention, not AI-training use, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
